title: Interpretable machine learning guides perovskite passivation molecule screening
summary: A SHAP-interpreted ML model relating six features to photovoltaic performance (about 100 literature data points) ranked hydrogen-bonding capacity and adsorption strength as most influential and guided screening of nine unexplored molecules. The lead molecule ATC raised the calculated iodide-migration barrier from 0.39 to 0.67 eV, and ATC cells reached 27.13% efficiency (26.59% certified stabilized) and kept 90% after 1460 h unencapsulated. Modules of 20.98 and 21.0 cm2 reached 24.01% and 21.14%.
ai_technology: Interpretable machine learning with SHAP on literature data for molecule screening

evidence.tested: Synthesis and device measurement, including certified efficiency.
evidence.unknown: Small training set; the benefit over unscreened molecules is not detailed in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML ranked features and guided choice of candidate molecules.
